titleStmt.title: Agreement Between the United States and Germany Terminating Parts of Article VII of the Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Consular Rights of December 8, 1923, Signed June 3, 1935

head.hi: Agreement Between the United States and Germany Terminating Parts of Article VII of the Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Consular Rights of December 8, 1923, Signed June 3, 1935

div.p: The undersigned duly authorized representatives of the United States of America and Germany on behalf of their respective Governments have reached the following Agreement:

The second, third, fourth, sixth and seventh paragraphs of Article VII of the Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Consular Rights between the United States of America and Germany signed December 8th, 1923, shall cease to have force and effect on and after the day on which this Agreement comes into force.

The present Agreement shall become operative on October 14th, 1935, and on and after that day shall have full force and effect as an integral part of the said Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Consular Rights.
The present Agreement shall be ratified, and the ratifications thereof shall be exchanged at Berlin as soon as possible.
Done in duplicate, in the English and German languages, both authentic, at the city of Washington, this 3rd day of June, 1935.

note.p: In English and German; German text not printed. Ratification advised by the Senate, August 24, 1935; ratified by the President, August 28, 1935; ratified by Germany, September 28, 1935; ratifications exchanged at Berlin, October 7, 1935; proclaimed by the President, October 25, 1935.
